bonds.title: Rates — 10Y remains a headwind
bonds.body: 10-year Treasury yield: 5.160% at Friday’s final 1-minute bar and 5.232% at the 09:19 ET bar (6:20 AM PT). The yield remained elevated and weighed on growth and technology shares, while the broader market traded near its highs.

bonds.title: Treasury auctions — mostly bills
bonds.body: No major coupon auctions this week. Scheduled auctions are mostly short-term bills.

macro.title: Macro calendar — the week ahead
macro.body: Tuesday: JOLTS. Wednesday: ADP, Q2 GDP, PCE / Core PCE. Thursday: Jobless Claims and ISM Manufacturing. Friday: Nonfarm Payrolls and Unemployment Rate.

macro.title: Trump announcement — 2:00 PM ET / 11:00 AM PT
macro.body: The White House schedule lists an announcement at 2:00 PM ET / 11:00 AM PT today, but does not specify the subject.

news.title: NVDA — another $150B buyback authorization
news.body: NVIDIA added another $150B to its share-buyback authorization overnight.

news.title: Headline risk — U.S.–Iran negotiations
news.body: The tape is responding well to expectations that negotiations will continue this week. Any new U.S.–Iran headline can flow through oil, yields, and QQQ / semis.

news.title: Oil / Middle East — inverse to equities
news.body: Oil is still trading inverse to equities. CL is following through on the selloff after negative U.S.–Iran news. Markets are now responding to expectations that negotiations will continue this week.

indices.title: Market snapshot — premarket futures
indices.body: VIX: 14.84 at Friday’s final 1-minute bar; 16.01 at the 09:19 ET bar (6:20 AM PT). Friday close is the 3:59–4:00 PM ET bar; the scan price is the last completed bar before 9:20 AM ET. Percentage changes are calculated from the displayed futures prices. The tape is responding well to NVIDIA buyback news and expectations that U.S.–Iran negotiations continue this week.
indices.source: TradingView Official MCP · 1-minute OHLCV · ES, NQ, YM, RTY and VIX · provider delay notice: 15+ minutes · retrieved 2026-09-29T02:27:16Z

indices.title: Keep an eye on relative strength
indices.body: Watch oil, the 10Y yield, semiconductor relative strength, VIX, and any new U.S.–Iran headlines. The main setup remains: U.S.–Iran headlines → oil → yields → QQQ / semis.

earnings.title: Catalyst watch — MU after the close Wednesday
earnings.body: Micron is the key earnings report for the broader market this week because of its read-through to AI memory and semiconductors.
